learnings.hypothesis: Lower-tier crates must never depend on higher-tier crates. The layer order is: Core Engine → Extraction → Delivery → Secondary.
learnings.reason: DR-2024-007, classification.json. This prevents circular dependencies and keeps the dependency graph acyclic.
learnings.guardrail_advice: Before adding a dependency, check the layer of both crates. Use `sruja drift -r .` to verify.

learnings.hypothesis: WASM-only crates (sruja-wasm) must not use native-only APIs: std::fs, std::net, std::process, threads, tree-sitter, fastembed.
learnings.reason: DR-2024-003, classification.json forbidden_patterns. WASM runs in browser/Node where these APIs don't exist.
learnings.guardrail_advice: If modifying sruja-wasm, verify no native-only imports. Run `just test-wasm` after changes.

learnings.context: error handling: use Result with thiserror
learnings.hypothesis: Use Result<T, E> with thiserror for all error types in Rust crates. Never use anyhow in library crates (CLI only).
learnings.reason: DR-2024-001. Rust crates use Result natively. Anyhow is acceptable only in sruja-cli for error propagation.
learnings.guardrail_advice: Define error enums with #[derive(Error, thiserror)]. Use ? operator for propagation. Never unwrap() in production.

learnings.context: architecture: JSON as primary export format
learnings.hypothesis: JSON is the canonical machine-readable export format. All DSL information is serialized to structured JSON.
learnings.reason: DR-2024-006. MCP tools, CI, and AI agents consume JSON. YAML/XML were considered but rejected.
learnings.guardrail_advice: Export paths should produce valid JSON. Use serde_json for serialization. Support --format json|text|github-actions.

learnings.hypothesis: No other crate should depend on sruja-cli. It is the top-level entry point that composes all other crates.
learnings.reason: classification.json forbidden_patterns. CLI is the delivery mechanism, not a library.
learnings.guardrail_advice: If another crate needs CLI functionality, extract it into a shared crate instead.

learnings.context: architecture: C4 is one profile among many
learnings.hypothesis: C4 is demoted from universal model to one profile. Libraries, data pipelines, and governance use different profiles.
learnings.reason: DR-2025-005. View-driven export controls what appears in markdown. Backwards compatible (no views = auto-C4).
learnings.guardrail_advice: When modeling non-C4 domains, define a profile with custom element kinds and diagram styles.

learnings.hypothesis: AI produces garbage without shared understanding. Reach consensus first, write spec, then code.
learnings.reason: AGENTS.md 'Before Coding' section. Re-running the compiler to fix AI errors just produces more garbage.
learnings.guardrail_advice: Use 'grill me' skill or equivalent questioning before non-trivial changes. Write the spec first.

learnings.context: agent: CLI-first autonomous agent with deterministic independent grader
learnings.hypothesis: Sruja owns the full observe → act → verify → critique → replan loop as a CLI-first autonomous agent. The deterministic layer (lint, drift, verify-task, intent check) is the independent grader; it never grades itself. The LLM critic is advisory; only the deterministic verifier can veto convergence.
learnings.reason: GROUNDED_HARNESS_AND_CONTINUAL_LEARNING.md §1 (loop-engineering thesis). `sruja agent loop` is the canonical autonomous path; `agent run/plan/apply` remain as headless/CI helpers.
learnings.guardrail_advice: The actor (sruja-agent) writes code; the deterministic grader (verify-task) approves. Never treat the LLM critique score as authoritative. Fail-to-pass + pass-to-pass tests are ground truth.

learnings.context: verify: Skipped steps do NOT count as pass
learnings.hypothesis: Verification steps marked Skipped (allowlist mismatch) are NOT considered passing. Only Ok results count. This prevents the agent from bypassing verification via allowlist misconfiguration.
learnings.reason: sruja-agent/src/verify/mod.rs:178-181. Changed from `is_pass()` (Ok|Skipped) to pure Ok check. `all_passed` returns false when every step is Skipped.
learnings.guardrail_advice: If verification fails, fix the allowlist or the command. Don't rely on Skipped as an implicit pass.

learnings.context: critique: keyword fallback rejects 'do not approve'
learnings.hypothesis: Critique keyword fallback (when JSON parse fails) requires 'approved' at line start or after newline. 'I do not approve' or 'do not approve' are rejected. This prevents false-positive approvals from malformed LLM output.
learnings.guardrail_advice: If critique parse fails, the default is reject (score 0.3). The keyword fallback only recognizes explicit 'Approved' markers.
